purpose: post-hoc five-seed stability and nominal-interval audit of the fixed 5-Hz source-conditioned workflow
member_definition: same 25 receiver-training records, architecture, losses, and two-stage budgets; independent initialization and mini-batch sampling seed
evaluation_events: the eight already inspected cross-region FD records
source_search: unchanged cross_region_fmm_protocol.json PINN inversion settings applied independently to every member
interval: component-wise member mean plus or minus 1.96 times the sample standard deviation
reporting: all five member estimates for x, y, z, and origin time for every event
component-wise empirical coverage and mean interval width
per-member mean and median location and origin-time errors
complete measured training and inversion cost
interpretation_limit: The evaluation records were used in earlier model and search diagnosis. Results measure post-hoc seed dispersion and cannot establish calibrated out-of-sample uncertainty. No Gaussian sampling-distribution claim is made for M=5.
